backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Matka gambling platform, defining data types (User, Bet, Market, GameResult, etc.) and state maps for deposits, withdrawals, bets, markets, and transactions, with user registration and role-based access control via mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three implemented features—market lobby result display, dedicated Results page, and useGameResultsQueries hook—to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON catalog of per-file summaries for frontend source files, describing the purpose of each component, hook, page, and utility in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Matka Pro frontend, loading the React app via main.tsx and setting the page title and favicon.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (MarketLobby, BetPlacement, MyBets, Wallet, AdminPanel, Results), React Query, theming, and a profile setup gate modal.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Full-page access denied screen with a shield icon, error message, and a back-to-markets link, shown when a non-admin user attempts to access the Admin Panel.
frontend/src/components/BalanceDisplay.t: Empty file placeholder for the BalanceDisplay component.
frontend/src/components/BetConfirmationD: Alert dialog component that shows a summary of a pending bet (market, type, number, amount, expected payout) and lets the user confirm or cancel before the bet is submitted.
Renders a table of a user's bet history with columns for market, bet type, number, amount, status (won/lost/pending), payout, and date. Shows an empty state message when no bets exist.
frontend/src/components/BetNumberInput.t: A controlled numeric input component for entering a bet number, enforcing digit-only input and max length based on the selected bet type, with error display.
Renders a grid of selectable bet type buttons (single, jodi, panna variants) showing labels and payout multipliers, highlighting the currently selected type.
frontend/src/components/DepositForm.tsx: A form for submitting a deposit request with amount (including quick-select buttons) and UTR reference fields, validating inputs and calling the deposit mutation with success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/DepositRequestsT: Displays a table of pending deposit requests for admins, with approve and reject action buttons that trigger the corresponding mutations and show loading states.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout component with a sticky header containing the logo, navigation links (conditionally shown based on auth/admin status), wallet balance display, and a login button, wrapping page content via an Outlet.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing appropriate icons and a loading spinner during the login process.
frontend/src/components/MarketCard.tsx: Renders a clickable card for a single betting market, displaying its name, open/close times, status badge, and latest result with a themed gradient accent.
frontend/src/components/MarketManagement: Displays an admin table of all markets with their open/close times and status, allowing toggling between open and closed states via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/PlatformStatsCar: Renders a responsive grid of platform-wide statistics cards (active users, total bets, payout, deposits, withdrawals) with icons and color-coded styling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new users to choose a username, validates input, and saves the profile via the backend actor on submit.
frontend/src/components/ResultDeclaratio: An admin form for declaring game results by selecting a market and entering open number, close number, and jodi values, then submitting via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/TransactionHisto: Displays a user's transaction history sorted by date in a table, with color-coded badges and amounts distinguishing credits (deposits, winnings) from debits (bets, withdrawals).
frontend/src/components/WithdrawalForm.t: A form component that allows users to submit a withdrawal request by entering an amount and UPI ID, with validation against minimum amount and available balance.
frontend/src/components/WithdrawalReques: An admin table component that displays pending withdrawal requests with approve/reject action buttons, using mutations from useAdminQueries.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: A collection of React Query hooks for admin operations including fetching pending deposits/withdrawals, platform stats, approving/rejecting requests, and declaring game results.
A hook that fetches the authenticated user's bet history from the backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useBetQueries.ts: A mutation hook for placing bets that invalidates bet history and user profile queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGameResultsQueries: Provides a query hook to fetch game results for given market names with 30-second polling, plus a helper to extract the latest result for a specific market.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validity.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarketQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all markets (with 30-second polling), all game types, and a single game type by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and save the authenticated caller's user profile, with query invalidation on save.
frontend/src/hooks/useWalletQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for wallet operations: fetching transaction history, submitting deposit requests, and submitting withdrawal requests, with cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines a dark Matka-themed design system with custom CSS variables, utility classes for glows, gradients, and themed card/button styles.
frontend/src/lib/staticMarkets.ts: Defines static fallback Matka market data (Time Bazar, Milan Day, Kalyan, Sridevi) with today-relative timestamps, per-market accent colors, and a mergeMarkets utility that falls back to static data when the backend returns none.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page with tabs for platform stats, pending deposit/withdrawal requests, result declaration, and market management, including a form to create new markets with quick-fill presets for standard Matka games.
frontend/src/pages/BetPlacement.tsx: Bet placement page that lets authenticated users select a bet type and number, enter an amount, validate inputs, preview expected payout, and confirm/submit a bet for a specific market.
frontend/src/pages/MarketLobby.tsx: Market lobby page displaying all Matka markets (merged from backend and static data) with a hero banner, login prompt for unauthenticated users, and navigation to bet placement on market selection.
frontend/src/pages/MyBets.tsx: Page that displays a user's betting history with stats (total, won, pending) and a table of bets; requires authentication and fetches bet and market data via custom hooks.
frontend/src/pages/Results.tsx: Page that shows game results (open number, jodi, close number) for all Matka markets, with market filter tabs and sorted newest-first display.
frontend/src/pages/Wallet.tsx: Wallet management page showing balance, total deposits/winnings/withdrawals, and tabbed deposit/withdrawal forms with transaction history; requires authentication.
frontend/src/utils/currency.ts: Utility functions for converting between paise (bigint) and INR-formatted strings, and between rupees and paise; includes legacy USD-named aliases.
frontend/src/utils/matkaOdds.ts: Defines Matka bet type odds multipliers, labels, descriptions, payout calculation, and number validation logic for all five bet types (single, jodi, pannas).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (supporting both regular and hash-based routing), persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the Matka app's custom color palette (matkaRed, matkaGold, matkaDark), fonts, shadows, border radii, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Tracks the state of the Matka Pro lottery app project, including existing features (game results display, results page, React Query hooks) and pending feature requests (time shifts, minimum deposit, backend results storage).
